summary: A witness gets to a hearing because a coworker takes their child to camp after it opens.
realLife: Victoria Snyder told the Pittsburgh hearing that she brought her son to work that morning so a coworker could take him to camp when it opened.
gates: The witness has arranged a handoff that covers the hearing and camp schedule.
inGame: needs: the witness’s child-care handoff and the hearing time.

turns.what: The witness makes the drop-off personally.
turns.pulledBy: The hearing time moves past the camp opening.

turns.what: The witness asks for a later turn.
turns.writesBack: The committee can change the testimony order.
